description: This file defines a web scraper function for extracting recipe data from julieblanner.com pages. It uses 'request' to fetch HTML content and 'cheerio' to parse and extract specific recipe details, then returns a Promise resolving to a recipe object.

classes.name: RecipeSchema
classes.description: A schema object for storing recipe details, imported from helpers.

methods.name: julieblanner
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, parses recipe data, and returns a Promise resolving to the recipe object.
